Made for the love of the game.name × clubs.

Football knowledge. Five at a time.

Name five different clubs that fit the challenge. The daily round gives you 60 seconds. Practice is untimed.

One club, many ways to say itManchester United · Man Utd · مانشستر يونايتد
  • Use English or Arabic, with or without accents. Small spelling mistakes are fine when the club is clear.
  • Send one name at a time, or a list separated by commas, newlines, or “and”.
  • If a name could mean more than one club, add the city or country. Different names for the same club only count once.
  • Daily challenges reset at midnight UTC. Your round and results are saved on this browser.

This first edition includes a curated club collection, not every club in the world. If we miss one, try its full name.
